task.description:
Design a shared pagination module for API-06 that centralizes cursor-based pagination logic currently duplicated across multiple endpoints.

API-06 requires:
- All list endpoints SHALL support cursor-based pagination
- Page size configurable per request, default 50, max 200
- Cursors are opaque base64-encoded strings; clients MUST NOT parse them
- Cursors expire 24 hours after creation → HTTP 410
- A cursor from one endpoint MUST NOT be usable on a different endpoint
- Response includes a `cursor` field when more pages exist; absent on last page

Current state (cursor logic duplicated in each handler):
- tasks.zig: "T:" prefix, base64url_no_pad, format "T:{created_at_us}:{task_id_hex}"
- instances.zig (list): similar pattern
- instances.zig (history): "H:" prefix, format "H:{now_us}:{seq}"
- definitions.zig: likely has its own cursor format
- event_store/store.zig: global stream uses after_global_seq, history uses after_sequence

Design goals:
1. Create a shared `src/api/pagination.zig` module with:
   - Cursor encode/decode (base64url, prefix validation)
   - Cursor expiry check (24h)
   - Page size validation (1-200, default 50)
   - Standard PageResponse<T> struct
2. Define a migration path: refactor existing endpoints to use the shared module
3. Ensure no breaking changes to external API contracts

Produce a design artifact at src/design/api-06-pagination.md covering:
- Public API of the pagination module (Zig structs and functions)
- Cursor format specification (prefixes per endpoint, encoding)
- Page size validation strategy
- Cursor expiry mechanism
- Migration plan for existing endpoints
- Error taxonomy (422 for invalid cursor/page_size, 410 for expired)

Do not write implementation code.
acceptance_criteria: Design covers shared Cursor type with encode/decode/expiry
Design covers PageSize validation and PageResponse<T> struct
Migration plan for 4+ existing endpoints specified
No breaking changes to external API contracts

result.summary: Design artefact for API-06 pagination module: centralized cursor-based pagination with shared Cursor type, encode/decode/expiry, PageSize validation, PageResponse<T> struct, and migration plan for 4 existing endpoints (tasks, instances list, instances history, definitions).
result.next_action: Route to BACKEND-DEV (Step 2a) for pagination.zig implementation, then FRONTEND-DEV (Step 2b) for web/src/hooks/usePagination.ts alignment
